stemMd: A group combines students with average score 60 and students with average score 90, with at least one student in each subgroup. Which combined average is impossible?
explanationMd: A weighted mean with positive weight on both distinct values lies strictly between them. It cannot equal 90 while any positive weight remains on the subgroup averaging 60.

distractorRationale.c: This is achievable with equal group sizes.
distractorRationale.a: This is achievable with suitable positive subgroup sizes.
distractorRationale.d: This is achievable with a one-to-two lower-to-higher ratio.
distractorRationale.b: This is achievable with a two-to-one lower-to-higher ratio.
